summary: Frozen dataclasses for backend-neutral physical metadata: ColumnInfo, TableInfo (location: Namespace, column_names, qualified_name), NamespaceInfo (location: Namespace, name derived from the last path segment), CatalogInfo and IndexInfo.
extension_points: Backends populate the free-form metadata mapping on each dataclass with backend-specific details.
lifecycle_notes: TableInfo and NamespaceInfo carry a Namespace location instead of separate namespace/catalog strings; NamespaceInfo.name is a derived property.
documentation_hooks: Inspection chapter: shape of each dataclass and how qualified_name is composed.
IndexInfo fields (unique, is_primary, index_type, included_columns, is_valid, definition) for index introspection.
risks: Field changes on these frozen dataclasses break consumers that construct or destructure them; the namespace/catalog fields were already replaced by location.

evidence.detail: All five re-exported at package root
